features.description: Wire BehaviorScheduler to runtime — morning greeting, break reminders, idle comments fire on schedule
steps: Verify BehaviorScheduler triggers morning_greeting between 8-9am
Verify break_reminder fires after 60min continuous activity
Verify idle_comment fires after 10min idle
Verify trigger cooldowns prevent duplicate firings
Verify scheduler records activity timestamps correctly

features.description: Auto-update detection — detects new version and offers to install
steps: Configure update endpoint in tauri.conf.json
Verify app checks for updates on startup
When new version available, verify update notification appears
Verify user can accept or dismiss update
Verify update downloads and installs correctly

features.description: Windows installer — .msi installs, runs, uninstalls cleanly
steps: Build Windows installer: cargo tauri build
Run .msi installer and verify installation completes
Verify app appears in Start Menu
Verify app launches from Start Menu shortcut
Uninstall via Add/Remove Programs
Verify all files are cleaned up

features.description: macOS installer — .dmg installs, runs, uninstalls cleanly
steps: Build macOS installer on macOS hardware
Open .dmg and drag to Applications
Verify app launches from Applications
Move to Trash and verify cleanup
Launch app and let it idle for 60 seconds
Measure RAM usage via Task Manager / Activity Monitor
Verify RAM < 50MB
Measure CPU usage over 30 second window
Verify average CPU < 5%

features.description: Performance with active LLM call — <200MB RAM, <15% CPU
steps: Launch app with LLM provider configured
Send a chat message to trigger LLM call
During active streaming response, measure RAM
Verify RAM < 200MB during LLM call
Measure CPU during response streaming
Verify average CPU < 15%

features.description: Offline operation — app works without internet using rule-based behavior only
steps: Disconnect from internet
Launch app (or restart if already running)
Verify pet appears and animates normally
Verify pet walks, falls, reacts to cursor
Open chat and send a message
Verify rule-based fallback generates a response (no error/crash)
Verify care system works offline
Verify settings are accessible offline

features.description: Graceful data corruption recovery — app recovers from corrupted database or config
steps: Corrupt the SQLite database file (write garbage bytes)
Launch app and verify it detects corruption
Verify app recreates database with fresh schema
Verify app continues running without crash
Verify default settings are loaded after recovery

features.description: Accessibility — keyboard navigation and screen reader support for settings
steps: Open settings panel
Navigate all controls using Tab/Shift+Tab
Verify focus indicators are visible
Verify Enter/Space activates buttons and toggles
Verify screen reader announces control labels
